summary: NOVANTA INC filed an 8-K to report entry into the Second Amendment to its Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment establishes $200 million of delayed draw term loan commitments available for borrowing within six months, maturing June 27, 2030, with interest rates based on base rate or SOFR/SONIA/EURIBOR plus margins tied to the company's consolidated leverage ratio. The loans amortize quarterly. This is a routine financing agreement—not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is involved. The filing simply modifies existing credit facilities to provide additional borrowing capacity.
